title: Roll for Initiative
content: Ihesitated prior to stepping into the cave. Rincewind insisted that it would contain the magical artifact we needed to complete our latest quest, but something inside of me said this was an absolutely awful idea. Nevertheless, we persisted and headed deeper inward, and I immediately became distracted by the presence of several different amazing species of whip-spiders. Suddenly, we came to a narrow passageway with a tight turn, which opened into a cavernous space. There, my darkvision revealed an unspeakable horror. A huge, globular mass... a massive mouth filled with far too many teeth... a gigantic eye... we had stumbled upon the lair of a beholder, an eye tyrant.11 Our leader reached for his greataxe as the beholder turned its attention to our group, clearly preparing to attack the smallest of our party first...
